pid_file.description: Path where the QEMU Guest Agent writes its PID file.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to disable file logging (only syslog is used).

log_verbosity.description: Log verbosity level: 0=INFO, 1=DEBUG, 2=TRACE, 3=CRITICAL. Higher values produce more logs.

fsfreeze_hook.description: Path to the script executed when the filesystem is frozen/thawed. Disable by setting to an empty string.

fsfreeze_hooks.description: Additional hooks to run during filesystem freeze/thaw events. Each hook defines a script path and optional arguments.

args.description: Optional command-line arguments passed to the hook script.

acpi_device_path.description: Enable QGA over ACPI device (recommended for standard KVM deployments). Set to 'no' to disable (e.g., for non-ACPI guests).
